1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.GeodesicEndpointStability
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FinitelyManyShortestRoutes
3 
4 /-! For prescribed endpoints, the compact family consists of exactly the
5 actual normalized shortest paths. In the canonical models its fibers are finite. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set BoundedContinuousFunction
10 
11 /-- All normalized shortest curves with these prescribed boundary endpoints. -/
12 def geodesicFiber (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : frontier P.body) : Set P.BoundaryCurve :=
13   {f | f ∈ P.geodesicCurves ∧ P.curveEndpoints f = (a, b)}
14 
15 theorem geodesicFiber_compact (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : frontier P.body) :
16     IsCompact (P.geodesicFiber a b) :=
17   P.geodesicCurves_compact.inter_right (isClosed_eq P.curveEndpoints_continuous continuous_const)
18 
19 /-- Every member of the fiber is the boundary curve of a genuine optimal surface path. -/
20 theorem geodesicFiber_path (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : frontier P.body)
21     (f : P.BoundaryCurve) (member : f ∈ P.geodesicFiber a b) :
22     ∃ path : P.SurfacePath a b, path.IsShortest ∧ path.length ≠ ⊤ ∧
23       LipschitzWith path.length.toNNReal path.curve ∧ path.boundaryCurve = f := by
24   have first : (a : Space) = (f 0 : Space) := congrArg Subtype.val (congrArg Prod.fst member.2).symm
25   have last : (b : Space) = (f 1 : Space) := congrArg Subtype.val (congrArg Prod.snd member.2).symm
26   obtain ⟨shortest, finite, speed⟩ := P.surfacePathOfCurve_shortest f member.1
27   refine ⟨(P.surfacePathOfCurve f).cast first last, ?_, finite, speed, ?_⟩
28   · exact SurfacePath.cast_shortest _ first last shortest
29   · exact P.surfacePathOfCurve_boundaryCurve f
30 
31 theorem geodesicFiber_nonempty (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a b : frontier P.body) :
32     (P.geodesicFiber a b).Nonempty := by
33   obtain ⟨path, shortest, finite, speed⟩ := P.exists_shortest_lipschitz_surface_path a.property b.property
34   refine ⟨path.boundaryCurve, path.boundaryCurve_geodesic shortest finite speed, ?_⟩
35   apply Prod.ext <;> apply Subtype.ext
36   · exact path.curve.source
37   · exact path.curve.target
38 
39 namespace SixVertexGraph
40 
41 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
42   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
43     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
44 
45 include graph small_faces in
46 /-- Distinct endpoints in a canonical model have a finite, nonempty compact geodesic fiber. -/
47 theorem geodesicFiber_finite (a b : frontier P.body) (different : a ≠ b) :
48     (P.geodesicFiber a b).Finite := by
49   have paths := graph.finite_shortest_routes small_faces a b (fun h => different (Subtype.ext h))
50   apply (paths.image SurfacePath.boundaryCurve).subset
51   intro f hf
52   obtain ⟨path, shortest, finite, speed, same⟩ := P.geodesicFiber_path a b f hf
53   exact ⟨path, ⟨shortest, finite, speed⟩, same⟩
54 
55 end SixVertexGraph
56 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
